name: vise-mod
description: In-process companion to vise: the active phase on the status line and in a pane, the phase in the system prompt, and tasky's failed fixes brought into a debug session

phase_in_system_prompt.title: Phase in the system prompt
phase_in_system_prompt.description: Add the active workflow's phase, its blocked tools and its exits as a section of the system prompt, rebuilt from graph_status every turn.

tasky_dead_ends.title: Failed fixes from tasky
tasky_dead_ends.description: When a debug workflow reaches its hypothesize or fix phase, ask tasky for fixes this repository already saw fail and add them to the conversation.
